learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn how to use Pronouns (I, You, He, She, It, We, They) to replace Nouns so sentences sound better.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 'Ravi is my friend. Ravi plays with me. Ravi is tall.' Oh no, repeating 'Ravi' is so boring! Let's learn some magic Replacing Words to make our sentences sound smart!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Words that are used in place of Naming Words (Nouns) are called Pronouns (सर्वनाम). They help us stop repeating the same names again and again.
examples_or_templates: Riya is singing. -> She is singing.
The ball is big. -> It is big.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When we talk about ONE person, animal, or thing, we use singular pronouns like He (for a boy/man), She (for a girl/woman), and It (for an animal/thing).
When we talk about MANY people or things, we use plural pronouns. 'We' (हम) is used for me and my friends together. 'They' (वे) is used for other people or things.
We use 'I' (मैं) when we talk about ourselves. We use 'You' (तुम/आप) when we talk to the person in front of us. 'I' is always written as a Capital Letter!

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which Pronoun will you use for your Mother?
❓ Fill in the blank: ___ are playing together in the park.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Replace the noun with a pronoun: 'The elephant is very big.' -> '____ is very big.'
subjective_practice.hint: What pronoun do we use for animals? (He / It)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank with We or They: 'Rahul and Amit are brothers. ____ love to share toys.'
subjective_practice.hint: You are talking about other people, not yourself. (They)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Rewrite correctly using a capital letter: 'you and i are friends.'
subjective_practice.hint: Remember the special rule for the pronoun 'I'!

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 Pronoun Pointing Game
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Stand in front of a mirror. Point to yourself and say 'I'. Point to your mom and say 'You'. Point to your toy and say 'It'. Play this game with 5 different things!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Pronouns take the place of Nouns.
⭐ He, She, and It are used for One person or thing.
⭐ We and They are used for Many people or things.
⭐ I and You are special pronouns we use every day!
